author: National Geographic
description:
Sandwiched between Lakes Mendota and Monona, Madison, Wisconsin, offers an effortless getaway with some 300 parks and more than 200 miles (322 kilometers) of hiking trails and bikeways to explore—including around Lake Wingra, which sits within the city limits. That network is set to grow next year when the city’s ambitious Madison LakeWay Project begins adding new trails and green spaces along the Lake Monona waterfront, eventually connecting the city's downtown to more of the shoreline.

author: National Geographic
description:
Amid the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto 6, discover how cars reshaped society, transformed industries, and helped define the modern world. In the first episode of Cars That Changed History from National Geographic, learn all about muscle cars. From Prohibition-era bootleggers to the Ford Mustang and Pontiac GTO, muscle cars transformed American motoring. Fierce rivalries, powerful V-8 engines, and a hunger for speed created a new breed of performance car that captured the imagination of a nation. Discover how these machines became enduring symbols of freedom, power and the American dream.
